label: A2B_cF24_227_c_a-001
title: Ideal $\beta$-Cristobalite (SiO$_{2}$, $C9$) Structure
comments:
This is an idealized version of the high-temperature phase of $\beta$-cristobalite originally proposed by (Wyckoff, 1925). 
 Below 530K it transforms into the \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tP12_92_b_a-001}{$\alpha$ cristobalite ($C30$) structure} (Pluth, 1985). 
 (Peacor, 1973) concludes that the oxygen atoms partially occupy the (96g) positions in the space group $Fd\overline{3}m$ \#227. We average those positions to put the oxygen on the (16c) sites and return to the original structure. 
 $\beta$-cristobalite is also known as ``high'' cristobalite. 
 More information about SiO$_{2}$ structures can be found in our article on \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$}.
